$description: Type scale. Entries with `figma` are the text styles in the Figma file, verbatim (px → rem at 16px). Entries marked proposed are not in Figma yet. Sizes in rem; lineHeight is a multiplier; letterSpacing in em.

subheading.$note: Figma: Dosis SemiBold 32px; alt is Dosis ExtraLight 32px.

header.$note: Figma: Montserrat Alternates ExtraBold 64/40/32/20/16px. Alts are Light 300 (heading 1 - alt is Open Sans Light). Figma names: Page Title, Supportive Tagline, Section Heading, Paragraph Heading, Block Heading, Small Important Heading.

body.$note: Figma defines only 16px regular/bold (line-height 100%). xl/lg/sm/xs and the 1.4 line-height are proposed.

label.$note: Proposed (Caldera-style UI labels). Not in Figma yet.

data.$note: Proposed (Space Mono for numbers). Not in Figma yet.
